subject: Argenta: stakeholder confirmation, procurement timeline, and enablement package
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sara Holt <sara.holt@argenta.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-04-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Argenta: stakeholder confirmation, procurement timeline, and enablement package

Hi Sara — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery + proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Call recap
- Primary use case: customer support automation + internal knowledge retrieval (priority: latency & auditability)
- Decision criteria called out: total cost of ownership, SLA/uptime, security evidence (SOC2/pen test), and integration timeline to production (target pilot in Q3).

Who you flagged during the call
- Champion / day-to-day: you (Sara) — internal supporter for PM and Ops
- Economic buyer: Natalie Park (CFO) — will own budget sign-off
- Security/infosec: Marco Ruiz — will own questionnaire and risk assessment
- Procurement: please confirm point person (I noted there might be a procurement specialist)

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm full names/emails for Natalie + Marco + procurement lead and attach any org chart you have? (helps us tailor the procurement checklist and one-pager)
2) We’ll send an ROI one-pager and a short mutual action plan for your review (attached drafts).
3) Suggested next meeting: 30-min alignment with procurement & security the week of May 4 — do any times there work?
4) If possible, share any internal timeline / blackout dates for billing or procurement windows.

Attachments included: Redwood_ROI_onepager.pdf (high-level economics), Argenta_MutualActionPlan.pdf (draft timeline + milestones)

Playbook for the champion (short bullets you can share internally)
- One-line summary: Redwood Inference provides predictable, lower-cost LLM inference with audited security controls and a single API across hosted/dedicated/private deployments.
- ROI highlight: reduce per-token inference cost by 20–40% via batching + caching for high-volume support workloads; reduce time-to-resolution via vector search + reranking (example metrics in ROI deck).
- Procurement ask: request a two-stage procurement (pilot agreement + production SLA amendment) to shorten PO timelines.

Happy to tailor language for Natalie/Marco — if you send their emails I’ll draft an intro note and a short two-slide finance summary.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood-inference.com

---
(Attachment stubs: Redwood_ROI_onepager.pdf (PDF, 1p); Argenta_MutualActionPlan.pdf (PDF, 2p))

From: Sara Holt <sara.holt@argenta.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-04-22T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Argenta: stakeholder confirmation, procurement timeline, and enablement package

Thanks Mina — great summary and useful framing. Confirmations below and a couple of asks: 

Confirmed contacts
- Natalie Park <natalie.park@argenta.com> — CFO, economic buyer (looped for budget discussions)
- Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@argenta.com> — Head of InfoSec (will run the security questionnaire)
- Procurement lead: Jules Martinez <jules.martinez@argenta.com> — handles vendor contracts/POs

I attached the latest org chart (Argenta_OrgChart_v2.pdf) — note that finance is reorganizing but Natalie is the right approver for now.

Requests from our side
- Can you send a concise cost band / pilot estimate (ballpark by tier) we can show to Natalie? We don’t need exact pricing in the deck, just ranges for a 3-month pilot vs production.
- Marco will need the SOC2 report + pen-test summary and some high-level data flow diagrams for our security review.

Scheduling
- I can do a 30-min procurement + security align on May 5 between 10–12 PT. Does that work on your side?

Thanks — I’ll introduce Natalie and Jules once we have the one-pager and cost bands.

Sara Holt
Head of Product Operations | Argenta Financial
Sara.Holt@argenta.com

---
(Attachment stubs: Argenta_OrgChart_v2.pdf (PDF, 1p))

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood-inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-04-22T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Argenta: stakeholder confirmation, procurement timeline, and enablement package

Internal — forwarding Sara’s confirmations. Quick enablement asks so we can arm the champion and move toward procurement: 

What I need from the GTM / enablement side (Ben):
- A 1-page finance slide with three pricing bands (pilot small: 100k tokens/day; pilot med: 500k tokens/day; production: 2M tokens/day) and expected monthly $ ranges (ballpark). Keep it conservative and include a clear callout for savings via batching/caching.
- A short email/template Sara can send to Natalie that positions the pilot as "risk-limited procurement" (one paragraph + 2 bullets).

What I need from Legal/Security (Laura):
- SOC2 summary + one-page answers to common infosec questions (data residency, logs, retention, access controls, KMS). Marco will want this up-front.
- A procurement checklist covering PO terms we typically accept vs ask for (SLA windows, termination, indemnity).

Attachments I’m including: Redwood_ROI_onepager.pdf (to share with Natalie as a starter); Argenta_MutualActionPlan.pdf (draft timeline).

Goal: have a draft finance slide + champion email + security pre-answers by EOD Apr 23 so I can loop Sara and propose May 5 for a procurement/security sync.

Thanks — feel free to edit the attached one-pager (link below) and I’ll own the intro/outbound to their execs.

Mina
mina.haddad@redwood-inference.com

(Attachment stubs: Redwood_ROI_onepager.pdf; Argenta_MutualActionPlan.pdf)
(Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b-argenta-sandbox)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-04-22T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Argenta: stakeholder confirmation, procurement timeline, and enablement package

All — I put a draft 1-pager in the Drive folder (same link Mina pasted). Key bullets for the champion email: 

Suggested champion email intro (one paragraph)
- "Natalie — quick note: we ran a short pilot with Redwood Inference to validate performance and cost controls for our support workload. Redwood’s approach lets us control latency and provides audit logs + SOC2 evidence; a 90-day pilot will let us validate economics before full procurement. Would you be open to a short finance sync next week?"

Finance slide highlights (short bullets you can copy into the 1-pager)
- Pilot 3-month estimate: $9k–$22k (small — depending on exact token mix)
- Production estimate (example): $28k–$120k / month (scaled by throughput and replication needs)
- Expected unit-cost improvement: 25–35% vs unmanaged endpoints (based on similar customers)

I also added two sentence-level answers for Marco on data flows and logs. Laura — can you confirm we can share the SOC2 summary + pen-test blurb in the Drive doc? If so I’ll finalize and Mina can send to Sara/Natalie.

Ben
ben.carter@redwood-inference.com

(Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b-argenta-sandbox)
